prompt:
Use case: product-mockup

Primary request: premium product photograph of one Indigo Bishnupur Baluchari Bengali saree, carefully folded with part of the pallav draped open so the weave, border and motif are clearly visible.

Style/medium: photorealistic premium Indian craft editorial product photography

Constraints: exactly one product design; visually distinct from other catalogue items; culturally respectful; accurate craftsmanship; no people; no mannequin; no text; no price tag; no logo; no watermark
Avoid: synthetic sheen, western bridal styling, excessive props, glitter effects, duplicate products, collage
